content_sections.heading: OPGC Senior General Manager - Finance Job Description
content_sections.text: Manage large-scale power sector debt, consortium banking relationships, and credit rating agency interactions. Oversee working capital, focusing on power distribution company (Discom) receivable management and PPA billings. Conduct regulatory financial analysis for tariff petitions to ensure proper billing and true-up recoveries. Execute long-term financial planning, capital structuring, and dividend distribution strategies. Lead corporate tax planning, input pricing between fuel procurement, and consolidated financial reporting. Monitor and analyze fuel costs, heat rate efficiencies, and auxiliary power consumption. Oversee plant-level cost accounting and inventory valuation. Manage operations cash flow, vendor payments, and statutory compliance. Track and control Plant O&M budgets, tracking breakdowns and shut-down financial impacts. Maintain the plant fixed asset register, tracking heavy machinery depreciation and capital spare parts.
